prompt.project_info: Create a polished full-body dark-romance fashion portrait in a warm minimalist studio.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with long dark wavy hair, soft bangs and two black bows, contemplative off-camera gaze, black off-shoulder gown with a large structural bow across the chest, secure bodice coverage, full tiered skirt pooling on soft white fabric, and delicate black sandals.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body portrait, subject leaning slightly back against a textured off-white wall, creamy beige and soft white environment, stark black gown contrast.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front-side light, gentle shadows defining facial contours and fabric folds, clean polished campaign atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 504x1002-style vertical composition, high fabric detail and realistic skin texture, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion vertical portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with long dark wavy hair, soft bangs and symmetrical black bows, contemplative off-camera gaze, black off-shoulder gown with a large structural chest bow and secure bodice, full tiered skirt pooling on soft white fabric, delicate black sandals, warm off-white studio wall, soft diffused light, realistic fabric and skin texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
